name: Lyrics card
description: Centred lines of lyrics, a verse or scripture in the lower part of the picture, with an optional reference line (song title, John 3:16).

params.name: lines
params.help: The lines to show, one per line (newline-separated), at most 6 lines; keep each line short

params.name: reference
params.help: Small line under the text: a song title, a verse reference like John 3:16 (empty: none)

example.lines:
Amazing grace, how sweet the sound
That saved a wretch like me

update.lines:
I once was lost, but now am found
Was blind, but now I see
